recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度高，骨小樑旁與間質中巨核細胞數量增加，且多數核為圓形或僅輕度分葉的小核（non-lobated/hypolobated），而非正常的多分葉核，符合 del(5q) MDS。
features: Hypercellular marrow adjacent to a bony trabecula with reduced fat
Increased megakaryocytes, scattered and in loose groups, including paratrabecular locations
Megakaryocyte nuclei predominantly round, non-lobated or hypolobated
Megakaryocytes of normal to slightly small size with moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm
Background of maturing myeloid and erythroid elements without obvious blast sheets at this power
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with a reduced proportion of fat adjacent to a bony trabecula. Megakaryocytes are increased and scattered singly and in loose groups, with a predominance of forms with round non-lobated or hypolobated nuclei and moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm. The background shows trilineage hematopoiesis without obvious sheets of immature cells at this magnification. Findings are consistent with the megakaryocytic dysplasia typical of myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q), which requires karyotype or FISH confirmation and blast enumeration on aspirate and CD34 immunostaining.

ddx.vs: ET shows large to giant megakaryocytes with hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei in a normocellular marrow, not non-lobated forms.
PMF megakaryocytes form dense clusters with bulbous, cloud-like hyperchromatic nuclei and are accompanied by reticulin fibrosis.

ddx.dx: MDS with other cytogenetics (micromegakaryocytes, separated lobes)
ddx.vs: Other MDS show micromegakaryocytes or widely separated nuclear lobes rather than predominantly normal-sized monolobated megakaryocytes; cytogenetics resolves the category.
Reactive megakaryocytes are increased but retain normal nuclear lobation, with no dysplasia in other lineages.
